claim.claim-text: 1. An operation method of user equipment (UE), comprising: receiving a Store and Forward (S & F) satellite operation parameter; starting a timer T3451 with a S & F wait timer duration value provided in the S & F satellite operation parameter; and while the timer T3451 is running, not initiating a non-access stratum (NAS) procedure over a S & F satellite cell in a tracking area identifier (TAI) list, unless the S & F satellite cell broadcasts a same satellite identifier (ID) broadcasted by the S & F satellite cell from which an accept message was received.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the S & F satellite operation parameter is received via an attach accept message.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the S & F satellite operation parameter includes an estimated S & F uplink delivery time duration field.

4. The method of claim 1, further comprising: while the timer T3451 is running, not initiating a NAS procedure over a satellite cell operating in a S & F mode in a tracking area identify (TAI) list assigned to the UE.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein the S & F satellite operation parameter includes a Store and Forward Monitoring List Indication (SFMLI) field.

6. A user equipment (UE), the UE comprising: at least one processor; and at least one computer memory operably connectable to the at least one processor and storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, perform operations comprising: receiving a Store and Forward (S & F) satellite operation parameter; starting a timer T3451 with a S & F wait timer duration value provided in the S & F satellite operation parameter; and while the timer T3451 is running, not initiating a non-access stratum (NAS) procedure over a S & F satellite cell in a tracking area identifier (TAI) list, unless the S & F satellite cell broadcasts a same satellite identifier (ID) broadcasted by the S & F satellite cell from which an accept message was received.
7. The UE of claim 6, wherein the S & F satellite operation parameter is received via an attach accept message.
8. The UE of claim 6, wherein the S & F satellite operation parameter includes an estimated S & F uplink delivery time duration field.

9. The UE of claim 6, wherein the operations further comprise: while the timer T3451 is running, not initiating a NAS procedure over a satellite cell operating in a S & F mode in a tracking area identify (TAI) list assigned to the UE.
10. The UE of claim 6, wherein the S & F satellite operation parameter includes a Store and Forward Monitoring List Indication (SFMLI) field.

11. A semiconductor chipset, comprising: at least one processor; and at least one memory capable of storing instructions and being connected electrically to the at least one processor operably, wherein operations, performed when the instructions are executed by the at least one processor, includes: receiving a Store and Forward (S & F) satellite operation parameter; starting a timer T3451 with a S & F wait timer duration value provided in the S & F satellite operation parameter; and while the timer T3451 is running, not initiating a non-access stratum (NAS) procedure over a S & F satellite cell in a tracking area identifier (TAI) list, unless the S & F satellite cell broadcasts a same satellite identifier (ID) broadcasted by the S & F satellite cell from which an accept message was received.
